title: Ender Be Gone
body:
# Ender Be Gone

## Problem

**Endermen can move blocks.** This is usually only a minor inconvenience because of their relatively low spawn rate. However, once you fully light up your world with torches, lanterns, or other light sources, Endermen become much more noticeable. Since most hostile mobs can no longer spawn in lit areas, Endermen make up a larger percentage of the remaining mob spawns.

Even though Endermen cannot spawn directly in torch light, they can still spawn:

* In nearby caves beneath your base
* Just outside the lit area
* In dark patches you may have missed

After spawning, they can teleport into your play space and start rearranging your blocks.

![Grass block placed by an enderman in an improper place](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a97c211dc650de7e4c6f7203dcb252f0cdbd989a.png)

## Why Not Just Disable Mob Griefing?

You *could* disable mob griefing with:

```mcfunction
/gamerule mobGriefing false
```

But this also disables behavior for many other mobs, including villagers, animals, and other non-hostile mechanics that players may still want enabled.

## Solution

This plugin specifically targets Endermen and prevents them from mutating your world. This way you don't have to worry about disabling other mob functions that might be useful in farms and such. 

### Features

* Prevents Endermen from picking up blocks
* Prevents Endermen from placing blocks

* Gives Endermen a configurable chance to spawn already holding a block
  * Default: `33%`
* Configurable scan radius for selecting held blocks
  * Default: `4 blocks`

## How It Works

When an Enderman spawns, the plugin scans nearby blocks within the configured radius around the spawn location. Any block contained in Minecraft's `enderman_holdable` tag can be selected, and the enderman will be spawned carrying that block. This way we can preserve the appearance and atmosphere of vanilla Endermen while preventing the terrain from being disfigured.
